json.task: Manage recruiting, onboarding, and talent bench in one place.
benefits: Connect HR operations directly to business revenue and client delivery.
AI drafts job descriptions and screens resumes.
AI insights alert early for high attrition risk.
Reduced average time-to-fill for technical roles from 45 to 21 days.
frictions: Initial setup to connect HR boards with sales and delivery took about 3 weeks.
Mobile app is not ideal for editing complex onboarding workflows.
